transcription: « Northern Construction Company, Limited, and J. W. Stewart. Montreal — Quebec — Three Rivers — Vancouver. Three Rivers, Que. May 29th. 1931. To all whom it concerns. The bearer Alphonse Demers has been in the employ of the Northern Construction Company Limited and J. W. Stewart, for the last five years, and during that time has been employed as a carpenter foreman, he was in charge of the concrete form-work at the New Harbour Works in Quebec at Wolfe's Cove, and also was in charge of the crib construction work in Three Rivers, and also form work for concrete in Three Rivers. We have no hesitation in recommending him to any one requiring such services, for he has at all times shown great ability, has always done reliable work, is steady, sober and very willing and obliging, he has blue print experience and is capable of taking charge of laying out work. Northern Construction Company Limited and J. W. Stewart, per [D. McLaughlin ?], Superintendent for Three Rivers, Que. » — Traduction : « À qui de droit. Le porteur, Alphonse Demers, est au service de la Northern Construction Company Limited et J. W. Stewart depuis cinq ans, comme contremaître charpentier. Il a eu la charge des coffrages de béton des nouveaux travaux du port de Québec, à l'Anse-au-Foulon (Wolfe's Cove), de la construction des caissons de bois (cribs) à Trois-Rivières, et des coffrages de béton à Trois-Rivières. Nous le recommandons sans hésiter : il a toujours montré beaucoup de compétence, fait un travail sûr ; il est régulier, sobre, très dévoué et serviable ; il sait lire les plans (bleus) et peut diriger l'implantation des ouvrages. »
